notes: Run of 2026-11-21. Five Hoodline stories queued; one names a building, a second account of the Olympic Club's purchase of the Inn at Union Square.

findings.description: The Olympic Club bought the 30-room Inn at Union Square for $8 million and plans to rename it.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Olympic Club Buys Union Square Hotel for $8 Million, Plans to Rename It,” 20 November 2026

raw.text: Olympic Club Buys Union Square Hotel for $8 Million, Plans to Rename It

publish.note: Declined: second account. The page already carries the sale as San Francisco Chronicle, “San Francisco’s Olympic Club just bought a Union Square hotel for $8 million,” 19 November 2026 (2026-11-20 run).

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 440 POST ST → parcel 0296007; sf-parcels has blklot 0296007 active, 434–440 POST; the 2025 roll records it as commercial hotel, built 1910. EAS puts 434, 440 POST ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 434.
